question: What does the angry one destroy across the triple world, moving and unmoving?
premises: sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ means all triple world
sa cara acaram means moving and unmoving
inference: The angry one destroys all moving and unmoving things in the triple world.
uncertainties: whether sa cara acaram is one phrase or separate
plain_english: When angry, he destroys all moving and unmoving things in the triple world.
